messages:
elaine: Quick preflight for the launch posts + benchmark narrative + webinar funnel. Main asks: keyword mapping sanity check, schema JSON-LD for webinar page, internal link heatmap for related posts, and redirect rules for the old /resources/ -> new /learn/ paths. Also we need final microcopy for CTAs so lead routing (SFDC) captures webinar source. Can folks 👍 and call out blockers?

sam: On it. I'll run a quick KW overlap vs primary landing page and surface conflicts. ETA 2 hours.

mona: I can QA schema. Can you paste the current JSON-LD? want to confirm @type and startDate format.

elaine: Pasting the current minimal snippet here:```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Launch & Benchmarks","startDate":"2024-05-12T11:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar-launch","description":"Launch demo + benchmark narratives"}```

jeff: For redirects, suggest a 301 rule on CDN edge. Example we used previously:```nginx
location ~ ^/resources/(.*)$ {
  return 301 https://redwood.ai/learn/$1;
}```

sam: KW quick notes: primary landing targeting "inference platform costs" and "LLM inference latency". Launch posts drifting into "LLM benchmarks" and "GPU inference" — overlap but okay. Recommend canonicalization to landing page for benchmark posts to avoid dilution.

mona: Schema: change startDate to local offset if webinar has registrant timezone conversion? Better to keep UTC like above. Also add "performer": {"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"} and add "potentialAction" for registration. Small PR incoming.

elaine: Great. Also we need internal linking plan: link the blog launch post -> benchmark narrative -> webinar sign-up -> docs (in that order). Can we get the heatmap of existing internal links from last crawl?

jeff: I exported internal link edges from Screaming Frog yesterday. Short list: blog->docs x 2, blog->webinar none, old resources->blog several. I'll attach the CSV to the ticket.

sam: Actionable: 1) Add rel=canonical on benchmark post pointing to landing (if it's an excerpt). 2) Ensure webinar signup page includes UTMs: utm_source=launch, utm_medium=blog, utm_campaign=bench_launch. 3) Redirects: /resources/* -> /learn/* as 301.

elaine: For lead routing: registrar form should set hidden fields utm_campaign and campaign_id. Jeff / ops — can SFDC mapping use campaign_id to auto-attach leads to the Bench Launch campaign?

jeff: Yes, add campaign_id as externalCampaignId on the form. Ops will pick it up. I'll coordinate with salesops after merge.

mona: PR created for schema changes and JSON-LD addition to the webinar page. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/842

sam: I pushed a tiny content diff to benchmark post recommending internal anchor to webinar section ("See live demo & metrics"). Also added canonical meta.

elaine: 🎉 Thanks. Final microcopy suggestions for CTA: 1) "Reserve your spot — see real LLM throughput" (primary) 2) "Compare latency & cost — register" (secondary). Which should be A/B?

mona: Both. Suggest split-test on hero CTA copy vs registration modal copy. Keep variant B for social posts.

jeff: Deploy plan: merge PRs, push redirect rule to CDN config, then smoke test URLs and form UTMs. I'll schedule a 15m post-deploy check at +30m.

sam: Nothing blocking from KW side. I'll add the KW map CSV to the ticket and flag any high-conflict terms.

elaine: Awesome. Can we confirm ownership and close the preflight by EOD? Owners: schema PR -> mona, redirects + CDN -> jeff, KW map + canonical -> sam, microcopy + launch post edits -> elaine.

mona: Confirmed.

jeff: Confirmed.

sam: Confirmed.

seo-bot: Reminder: scheduled crawl tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Will report on 301/200/404 status for affected paths. :robot_face:

elaine: Perfect. I'll update the launch checklist and mark this thread in the ticket. Thanks team :raised_hands:
